title: Thesis Writing 101
tagline: From topic selection to an approved proposal and defense-ready thesis.
description: Master the complete arc of empirical thesis writing: finding a bounded topic, passing proposal defense, synthesizing literature, aligning methodology, and crafting coherent chapters.

title: Citations & Referencing
tagline: Master APA 7th, Harvard, IEEE, and Vancouver with zero guesswork.
description: Learn parenthetical vs narrative in-text mechanics, resolve complex reference list formatting rules, match in-text citations to bibliographies, and use Zotero effortlessly.

title: Academic Integrity & Similarity Reports
tagline: Understand plagiarism policies, interpret Turnitin reports, and use AI ethically.
description: Navigate HEC Pakistan plagiarism thresholds (19% / 5% rule), differentiate between real overlap and legitimate exclusions, master 4-step paraphrasing, and disclose AI assistance.

title: Proofreading & Academic Editing
tagline: Transform rough thesis drafts into publication-ready academic manuscripts.
description: Execute the Three-Pass editing framework: argument structure, paragraph cohesion, and sentence mechanics. Fix common ESL grammar traps, article usage, and table styling.

title: Literature Search with Zotero
tagline: Systematic search strategies, open scholarly databases, and automated reference management.
description: Build nested Boolean strings for OpenAlex, Crossref, and PubMed. Evaluate peer-reviewed journals using the HEC HJRS index, avoid predatory publishers, and automate bibliographies in MS Word.

title: Sample Size & Research Methodology
tagline: G*Power calculations, sampling designs, instrument validity, and ethical research.
description: Calculate sample sizes using Cochran's formula and finite population correction. Compute statistical power and effect sizes in G*Power for t-tests, ANOVA, and regression.

title: SPSS Basics for Research Students
tagline: Clean data, run statistical tests, interpret output tables, and report in APA 7th style.
description: From data entry to descriptive statistics, screening outliers, testing normality, independent t-tests, one-way ANOVA, Pearson correlations, multiple regression, and Cronbach's alpha.

title: SmartPLS & SEM Introduction
tagline: Structural equation modeling, measurement validation, bootstrapping, and mediation analysis.
description: Master Partial Least Squares SEM. Assess reflective measurement models (outer loadings, AVE, composite reliability, HTMT criterion) and structural models (path coefficients, R-squared, f-squared, bootstrapping).

title: Viva & Presentation Coaching
tagline: Structuring defense slides, answering tough examiner questions, and delivering with calm confidence.
description: The 15-minute defense slide budget, handling the 10 inevitable examiner questions, answering 'I don't know' professionally, defusing hostile examiners, and morning-of defense protocols.
